requirements.requirement: A user signs in with username and password and receives a session token; invalid credentials are rejected with an explicit error and no token is issued.
An administrator creates a customer with name, national document, phone and email, and lists the registered customers.
An administrator registers a vehicle owned by an existing customer with plate, VIN, brand, model and year; a duplicate plate or a duplicate VIN is rejected.
An administrator opens a service order for a vehicle at check-in with the failure reported by the customer and the reception date; the order is created in RECEIVED status.
An administrator assigns a technician to a service order; the assignment is rejected when that technician already holds a service order that has not reached DELIVERED.
The assigned technician records the diagnostic of a service order with the finding and the components to repair, which moves the order to IN_DIAGNOSIS.
The assigned technician registers an intervention on a service order with description, labor hours and the parts used; the first intervention moves the order to IN_REPAIR.
A service order advances from IN_REPAIR to READY and from READY to DELIVERED; a transition outside the declared lifecycle is rejected and the order keeps its previous status.
Every service order status change is persisted as a transition record with the previous status, the new status, the author and the timestamp.
An administrator issues a warranty over an intervention with kind LABOR or PART and a coverage in months; the expiration date is computed as the issue date plus the coverage.
The system reports for any warranty whether it is valid or expired at the date being consulted, comparing that date against the expiration date.
requirements.rationale: Validity is a comparison between the consulted date and the persisted warranty.expiration_date served by ix_warranty_expiration_date; it introduces no new persistent storage.

requirements.requirement: An administrator consults the clinical timeline of a vehicle and reads, in chronological order, its service orders, diagnostics, interventions and warranties.
requirements.rationale: The timeline is a read-only chronological join over service_order, diagnostic, intervention, warranty and status_transition filtered by vehicle; it introduces no new persistent storage.

requirements.requirement: An administrator reads a dashboard with the number of open service orders, the count of service orders grouped by status, and the technicians currently holding an active order.
requirements.rationale: The dashboard is a read-only aggregation over service_order grouped by status and over assignment filtered by is_active; it introduces no new persistent storage.
